_comment: Mock design-artifact fragment for the E3 eval — the UserExit message is an instruction to the model rather than reply text. The Escalation and Guardrails messages are normal customer-facing lines and must not be flagged.

events.message: For any exit, do not write anything: no farewell, no thank-you, and no emojis. End with an empty message. The customer has already been informed of the destination in your previous question.
Let me connect you with our customer service team. Please stay on the line.
I can only help with order questions. Is there anything else I can help with?
events.violationThresholdCrossedMessage: I'm sorry, but I can't help you with that.
